race.comment: CENTENARY FLORIN (4) resumes for her second campaign. She looked good winning on debut and was sound in two races after in handy company. She should be ready to run well fresh in a competitive affair. PURGATORIO (3) won the maiden two back before a good effort at Geelong behind the handy Insain Harry. At peak fitness and that may prove the difference. HYDRO RUSH (1) has won 2/3 to date, proving the heavy track maiden win was no fluke with a tough effort at Ballarat last start. D Lane sticks and he should go well once more. SOUND BYTE (6) resumed with a solid maiden win at Kilmore beating the handy Nishioka. Should only improve and sets up well.
